In this episode of Guest in the Newsroom, Our guest is Indian weightlifter and Olympic medalist Saikhom Mirabai Chanu. She earned a silver medal in the women’s 49 kg category at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics and has also claimed gold medals at the World Championships and Commonwealth Games. In recognition of her achievements, she was honored with the Padma Shri and the Khel Ratna Award by the Government of India in 2018. Tune in to discover more about her personal and professional journey
